Sharing my personal experience...

I purchased a **brand-new Mahindra XUV700 AX7 Diesel AWD (₹33 lakh)** on **3rd August 2025**. Very early in ownership, the vehicle developed a noticeable **vibration at highway speeds (around 88–93 km/h)**. The issue continues even today as on 09.12.2025
espite multiple visits and extensive communication.

The vehicle has already spent **over 15 days in the workshop** (9 days in August and 6 days in November). I cooperated fully with every inspection, test drive, and request from the service team. Unfortunately, the concern remains unresolved.

During one of the discussions, I was informed that a replacement part might be sourced from another new vehicle. I immediately documented my objection, as I believe all replacements should come through proper OEM channels. I also requested a transparent, fully documented test procedure with:

* complete data logging
* continuous video recording
* highway testing at the actual vibration range
* documented observations
* presence of my representative
* a certified test report

These requests were made only to ensure clarity and accuracy. However, none of these conditions were addressed in the responses I received.

Several commitments — including follow-up communication, technical transparency, and issuance of certain documents — were either delayed or not fulfilled. Senior-level escalation did not lead to a clear resolution, and the vibration concern continues despite repeated follow-ups.

A new car represents years of savings and trust. My experience with the after-sales process has unfortunately been stressful, with the issue still unresolved after multiple attempts.

**This review reflects my personal experience and is shared in good faith, so other customers remain informed and can ensure all processes are clearly documented when seeking service support.**

featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited Aroma Cafe at The Hive once again, this time with friends, and it reminded us why we were happy to come back. Some places make a good first impression, but only a repeat visit tells you whether they truly maintain their standards. Aroma Cafe did exactly that—with good food, warm hospitality, and a vibe that instantly makes you feel relaxed.
The moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels bright, comfortable, and welcoming. It has that perfect café energy where you can sit for long conversations without feeling rushed. The interiors are pleasant, the seating is comfortable, and the overall ambience carries genuinely good vibes. Whether you’re meeting friends, working for a while, or just taking a break, the place feels easy and enjoyable.
What stood out once again was the hospitality. The staff were polite, attentive, and quick to help whenever needed. They were warm in their interactions and handled the service smoothly, which made our group outing even better. Good hospitality often defines the overall memory of a place, and Aroma Cafe gets this part right.
We ordered quite a spread so everyone could try something different, and the meal turned out to be both satisfying and enjoyable.
Creole Potatoes
A great starter with crispy potatoes tossed in flavourful seasoning. Nicely spiced, crunchy outside, and soft inside—perfect for sharing with friends.
Iced Cold Coffee
Refreshing, smooth, and nicely chilled. It had the right balance of coffee flavour and sweetness, making it ideal for a casual café outing.
Nutella Hot Chocolate
Rich, indulgent, and comforting. The Nutella gave it a creamy hazelnut twist that made it feel more special than a regular hot chocolate.
Veg Alfredo Pasta (Penne) with Extra Cheese Sauce
Creamy, filling, and comforting in every bite. The penne was cooked well, and the extra cheese sauce made it richer and more satisfying.
Coconut Matcha Cloud
A unique and refreshing drink with an interesting flavour combination. The coconut added smoothness while the matcha gave it a light earthy finish.
Mango Smoothie Bowl
Fresh, colourful, and enjoyable. The mango flavour was bright and naturally sweet, making it a lighter and healthier option on the table.
Creamy Garlic Mushroom
Full of flavour and very well prepared. The mushrooms were cooked nicely in a creamy garlic base that was rich without feeling too heavy.
Cheesy Garlic Bread
Warm, cheesy, and hard to resist. Crisp edges with soft bread inside, topped with enough cheese and garlic flavour to make it a crowd favourite.

Veg Spaghetti Aglio Olio Pasta
Simple yet flavourful. The garlic and olive oil coating was balanced, and the spaghetti had a clean, satisfying taste.
What we appreciated most was that despite ordering many different items, the quality remained consistent across the table. Portions were good, presentation was neat, and everything arrived at a comfortable pace. Nothing felt rushed, and we could enjoy the meal while catching up properly.
Another strong point is how suitable the café is for conversations. Some places are either too loud or too formal, but Aroma Cafe strikes a very good middle ground. It feels lively yet peaceful enough to talk comfortably, which is exactly what you want during a friends’ outing.
Cleanliness and upkeep were also impressive. The tables were maintained well, the service area looked organised, and the overall environment felt managed with care.
A repeat visit often comes with higher expectations, and Aroma Cafe lived up to them. Good food, pleasant ambience, and warm service came together once again to create a very enjoyable experience.
Overall, Aroma Cafe at The Hive continues to be a dependable and welcoming place for coffee, comfort food, and quality time with friends. With its good vibes, great hospitality, and consistent food quality, it remains a café we’d happily visit again. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a relaxed and enjoyable café experience.
